projectDesc.p: Digitally encoded for the Online Critical Pseudepigrapha (OCP) project from Logos Bible Software resource LLS:8.20.7.

editorialDecl.p: Word-level grammatical analysis follows the Heiser-Penner morphological tagging of the Greek Old Testament Pseudepigrapha, encoded using the TEI P5 att.linguistic attribute class (@lemma, @pos, @msd).
